name: postId
label: Post ID
help: The `id` of an Ampost post, for example from **Create a post** or **Search posts**.

name: text
label: New text
help: Replaces the published text. Media and links stay. Each platform's text length limit applies.

name: accountIds
label: Accounts
help: Leave empty to edit the post on every account where it is published. Instagram, Threads, TikTok, Bluesky and X have no edit API: those accounts keep their text, with a notice saying so.
